notes.title: Draft Class Feature Pack
notes.content:
The [b]Legend Bowl[/b] and [b]College Bowl[/b] universes collide in the all-new [b]Draft Class Feature Pack DLC![/b] Continue the journeys of your favorite College Bowl stars under the bright lights of the Legend Bowl football league. 

[previewyoutube=CFcbiXQY5vQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Draft class import [b](requires College Bowl for the draft class export)[/b] allows you to export players leaving the college ranks and import them into Legend Bowl. Players will carry over all of their player likeness attributes and accessories as seen in College Bowl. 

Their ratings will not be a 1:1 export and they have a hidden chance to boom or bust during the transition to the pros. For those who are technically savvy, you will have the ability to modify the draft class text file with custom players and ratings.

[h3]Features Included:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ability to import draft class from College Bowl into Legend Bowl. [i][b](requires College Bowl for the draft class export)[/b][/i]
[*] Updated jersey number graphics shown in game and replays.
[*] Auto replays now occur during a game.
[*] Difficulty sliders that allow for customizing the game to fit any challenge level.
[*] Updated play calling menu which matches College Bowl's system where you can choose plays more easily.
[*] All of the new player hair, hairstyles, gear, and accessories from College Bowl.
[*] New CRT setting for better retro experience than beforehand.
[*] Drones will now fly around during games.
[*] Streamlined color palettes to match College bowl (required for class export to work successfully).
[*] Base rosters upgraded to include all of these new graphics additions.
[*] ProSet rosters for the 2025 season.
[*] New team logos.
[*] Team socks option added to team editor.
[/list]
[h3]New Graphics Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Face covers
[*] Auto Replays
[*] Jersey Number Size
[/list]
[i]* Please note old custom roster player and team colors will no longer look at they did and we STRONGLY advise to remove all old rosters and franchise saves prior to installing this DLC. Basically, start with a fresh install and remove any old files from your user "AppData" directories. 

With that said, if you have player or team edits that you really want to save, you need to export them to a spreadsheet first. The Discord community can assist with this process if you need help.[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.007
notes.content:
College Bowlers!

Since we love gameplay as much as you do, we've done some tuning and fixes to help bring more immersion onto the field.

One of the things we strive for in our game is players [i]playing[/i] differently from one another, instead of all playing identically which we all know stinks!

With this update, we made some new changes to how Quarterbacks target receivers based on their attributes. We feel this brings more disparity between teams and involves even greater strategy when building your squad.

Soft traits like Leadership, Intelligence, Winner, and more already have various impacts across the game. Now, we've taken this one step further and have given Quarterbacks a more complex sense as to how they play and what decisions they make during each and every play.

For instance, a Quarterback who is a [b]STRONG[/b] leader, but has [b]LOW[/b] work ethic traits will try to target their primary receiver more often since they just want to make the right call. Or a [b]LESS[/b] intelligent, but [b]FAST[/b] Quarterback might take off and run without looking back to put the game on his own shoulders. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019725/780dd00bcf012cb25993869c4a7c31277f1cf247.png[/img]
There are more changes, but the goal is to think more about who you want in the driver's seat each game. This makes for some interesting roster choices and brings more life into the game.

Be sure to read below to get all of the details included in this update.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Quarterbacks with [b]HIGH[/b] Leadership (> 74) and [b]LOW[/b] Work Ethic (< 25) target primary receivers more often.
[*] Quarterbacks with [b]HIGH[/b] Winner (> 74) and [b]HIGH[/b] Greed (> 74) target to best skilled receivers more often.
[*] Quarterbacks with [b]HIGH[/b] Intelligence (> 74), [b]HIGH[/b] Work Ethic (> 74), and [b]LOW[/b] Strength (< 75) target to closest receivers more often.
[*] Quarterbacks with [b]HIGH[/b] Greed (> 74) and [b]LOW[/b] Intelligence (< 40) target to farther receivers more often.
[*] Quarterbacks with [b]HIGH[/b] Speed (> 84), [b]LOW[/b] Intelligence (< 50), and [b]HIGH[/b] Greed (> 80) take off running more often.
[*] Defenders try to block passes with grab tackle more often as swatting would take them out of the play more often than not.
[*] Logic that determines "open" receiver softened up a bit to not throw into extra coverage so often.
[*] Catching success when surrounded by defenders decreased.
[*] Fixed issue where primary receiver doesn't block when Quarterback takes off running.
[*] Fixed game not prompting to save roster after accepting changes in Player Editor.
[*] Fixed broken [b]3-4 OKIE > Stoops 1 Hard[/b] play.
[*] Updated patch notes link.
[*] Miscellaneous fixes and updates.
[/list]
[h2]Thank you[/h2]

We are so close to 200 reviews as of this update and can't thank our fans enough for their support!

If you experience any bugs or issues please report them here or more preferably on our [url=https://discord.gg/3yPN2DG]Discord[/url] server where you can chat with the community, report bugs, or give feedback on the game.

As always, if you've enjoyed the game so far and like what you're seeing out of the game it would be great if you can leave us a review on Steam! 🙏

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.005
notes.content:
College Bowlers!

We hope everyone is enjoying the game and getting their [b]College Football[/b] fix on! We're actively listening to feedback and bug reports and will continue to do so, in order to improve the game as much as possible.

This update includes several updates to gameplay we think you're going to enjoy. For starters, the blocking engine was somewhat broken for a majority of plays due to blocking routes being longer than one segment. This caused blockers to turn around and run to their spots, as opposed to back pedaling like they should have been doing. We've now cleaned up these plays to remove unnecessary routes to create better drop backs and make blocking more realistic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019725/733cc031ec724431af23a54e3aa89289c10dd502.gif[/img]

We then took it one step further because we really believe the o-line/d-line interactions are key to a great football game and we wanted to create a better pocket for Quarterbacks to thrive in. Prior to this update, blockers would immediately run forwards and not form a cohesive pocket. Now blockers drop back by strafing and getting into much better positions before attacking their assigned defender. We're super excited to hear what you think, so be sure to share your cool "pocket" shots with us. 😎

The final item we wanted to share was the changes to the play calling UI. People have been telling us for a long time that scrolling one play at a time was a chore. This was never a simple fix because of the way the play calling logic was written. 

The fact that we have almost 3,000 plays has made finding plays much more difficult, so now you can scroll 4 plays at a time and choose a button for each play. We also removed the "Disguise" and "10x" buttons because they are no longer needed. This will be a nice upgrade for those that love digging through playbooks searching for the perfect play.

Be sure to read below to get all of the details included in this update.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Play calling UI improved QoL when calling plays. Now you can choose up to 4 plays with a button and you can scroll by page as opposed to needing to scroll 1 play at a time.
[*] Fixed issue when performing an onside conversion where the game would lose track of being in an onside conversion after a delay of game penalty or offsides.
[*] Blocker AI improved to now drop back and form a pocket for the quarterback as opposed to just running forward.
[*] Blockers won't turn around when dropping back unless the play has them assigned to more than one route segment.
[*] Blockers drop back animation changed to be grab vs just run back.
[*] Blockers drop back speed increased.
[*] Zone strafe issues improved.
[*] Fixed throwing game freeze issues that occurs when throwing ball away.
[*] Fumble slider values have more affect on fumble frequency.
[*] Field stat messaged updated with fixes.
[*] Plays filed updated with fixes and improvements.
[*] Updated patch notes link.
[*] Miscellaneous fixes and updates.
[/list]
[h2]Thank you[/h2]

We are creeping towards 200 reviews and can't thank our fans enough! Let's spread the word and keep this game relevant, so others can enjoy the game as well. We know football fans want more football and College Bowl is ready to show them what it has to offer.

If you experience any bugs or issues please report them here or more preferably on our [url=https://discord.gg/3yPN2DG]Discord[/url] server where you can chat with the community, report bugs, or give feedback on the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.004
notes.content:
Hey College Bowlers!

Now that the game is out in the wild, we've had more time to analyze feedback on gameplay and other issues reported by our community.

With that said, we focused a lot of our time on Defense, in particular the AI gameplay logic to help manage all of the various offensive and defensive combinations that can occur during a game. That's one of the downsides to having SO MANY plays in our game, your engine needs to be bulletproof. 

Choosing the best defense to combat the offense is crucial and we feel confident the game is in an even better state that it was before and that's saying something. In addition, player ratings have a significant impact on how games function. We also have to navigate difficulty levels and sliders. So yeah, many variables and football is not the simplest sport to replicate! 😊

In short, we were seeing offenses pummel defenses at times and we're hoping this update helps nerf some of those exploits. Please let us know how you like the changes? We're very interested in hearing your thoughts!

Be sure to read below to get all of the details included in this update.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Defenders in short and deep zones now strafe toward closest man, instead of just standing in one spot.
[*] Defenders react faster when ball is thrown to receiver.
[*] Blitzers no longer finish initial route when Quarterback is trying to run the ball.
[*] Run blocking effectiveness decreased.
[*] Roll out QB's no longer tend to throw it across their bodies towards the other side of the field.
[*] Deep zone coverage AI heavily improved for better coverage.
[*] Kick return blocking success decreased to try and reduce the frequency of kick returns.
[*] Pass and Run blocking got a boost and sliders tuned for more impact.
[*] New plays added to playbooks.
[*] Fixed crash that can occur when enabling auto replays during a game.
[*] Dynasty bowl trophies fit page better when more than 14 trophies owned.
[*] Custom trophy logo image centering issue fixed.
[*] Reordered graphics settings menu items.
[*] Fixed crash bug that would occur during spring training progression.
[*] Updated patch notes link.
[*] Miscellaneous fixes and updates.
[/list]
[h2]Thank you[/h2]

We are approaching the 150 review mark! Let's see if we can get to 200 before our next update? That would be special! Please share the game with friends and family! We need all the help we can get!

If you experience any bugs or issues please report them here or more preferably on our [url=https://discord.gg/3yPN2DG]Discord[/url] server where you can chat with the community, report bugs, or give feedback on the game.

As always, if you've enjoyed the game so far and like what you're seeing out of the game it would be great if you can leave us a review on Steam! 🙏

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.003 - Day 3 Update
notes.content:
Hey College Bowlers!

Missed us much? Well we're back again with another update that will help with the Defensive AI where players were being left uncovered, resulting in huge plays down field. With the help of our community during our [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/niexzXFex9E?si=KAVpGFbJklYre3Tx]live stream[/url], we nailed down logic to clean up the missed targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019725/7b545f953ba9e352d8e888b4d4408f09d9a67e64.png[/img]

We hope you're enjoying the game and beating up on your college buddies with you favorite college teams, like the glory days of sports gaming!

We also added several settings that allow you to fine tune CRT options to get the best retro experience possible. [i]It took way to long to do, but we're glad we did it![/i] ːsteamhappyː

Be sure to read below to get all of the details included in this update.

[list]
[*] Defensive deep zone AI improved for better coverage on receivers and quicker responses to ball carrier runs.
[*] Plays have been updated to align with better deep zone play logic.
[*] Dodge tackles success rate slightly tuned down.
[*] Blocking sliders split into pass and run blocking sliders for more control.
[*] Fixed hats being drawn on mascots on title screen.
[*] CRT settings added to graphics menu for more fine tuning.
[*] New auto zoom setting in graphics that controls if camera zooms down to field in between plays.
[*] Randomizing teams rapidly by button mashing no longer gets stuck in loop forcing a quit.
[*] Updated patch notes link.
[*] Miscellaneous fixes and updates.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.002 - Day 2 Update
notes.content:
Hey College Bowlers!

Back at you again with another update! We are working hard to address any issues and/or feedback we're receiving from players in our community.

We also appreciate all of the support we've received in terms of Reviews. For those who are installing mods, please note you must use that at your own risk and the game is not liable for any negative experiences you have while playing the game.

Now onto the update!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed modded logos not showing up on the field.
[*] Disabled news tickers as default settings as they can cause intermittent lag on weaker machines.
[*] Fixed game version on credits screen.
[*] Time to choose defensive play after revealing offensive package bumped up from 9 secs to 15 secs to give more time to choose defensive play.
[*] Fixed issue when CPU goes for two point conversion and USER calls timeout where they get stuck in an offensive play during the extra point.
[*] Fixed referee ball spot issue during two point conversion calling timeout sequence.
[*] Fixed issue where kicking a short field goal with USER controlled team from far away, causes ball to travel far.
[*] Fixed issue where team's time of possession wasn't tracking correctly.
[*] CPU SIGN changed to now read NEXT PAGE.
[*] Discipline newspaper message spacing issues fixed.
[*] Fixed crash bug that would occur during Disciplinary events because new players did not have a "suspended" tag for new recruits that get populated during the off-season.
[*] Attempt to fix undefined field stat message issue.
[*] Fixed issue where clock would run faster during play when accelerated clock is enabled.
[*] Fixed a soft lock freeze that would occur when throwing the ball away using the left trigger.
[*] Increased brightness on CRT screen mode.
[*] Updated patch notes link.
[*] Miscellaneous fixes and updates.
[/list]
[h2]Thank you[/h2]

We are also on the #1 for New Trending games on the Sports categories in Steam US. We are so glad many of you liked the game. If you haven't already, feel free to send us your opinions as a review on Steam Reviews.

If you experience any bugs or issues please report them here or more preferably in our [url=https://discord.gg/3yPN2DG]Discord[/url] where you can chat with the community, report bugs, or give feedback on the game.

As always, if you've enjoyed the game so far and like what you're seeing out of the game it would be great if you can leave a review on Steam! 🙏

[url=https://discord.gg/3yPN2DG]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.001 - Day 1 Update
notes.content:
Hey College Bowlers!

We've been crawling in the Steam Discussion Boards and Discord gathering feedback and issues reported by our fans.

We are overwhelmed with the amazing reception so far. We also heard your feedback about the game's issues and bugs. We are slowly taking steps to improve the game as we listen to the community.

People have had some issues loading/saving Dynasty saves and the best way to resolve the issue is to cleanout your "C:\Users\YOUR NAME HERE\AppData\Local\college_bowl" folder and reinstall the game. Also, disable Steam Cloud as the game is not geared to utilize it just yet. Stay tuned for more news on adding that feature down the road!

Be sure to head on over to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1226160/discussions/0/6193093412362900851/]FAQ[/url] if you're new to the game and want to have all of the tips and hints in your back pocket before hitting the field!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Defenders now turn around when assigned target has engaged in a blocking battle in order to see ball carriers and not just stand facing north.
[*] Fixed defenders diving erroneously when ball tossed to player during run or option plays.
[*] Fixed issue where you can back out of the Graduation process while it's running.
[*] Decreased tackle dive range to lower the frequency of missed tackles.
[*] Passing yards now decrease for sacks.
[*] Recruiting received new filtering by available players and sorting by gem, bust, and interest to better view prospects.
[*] Recruiting pitch popup displays tiers and green, yellow, orange, red colors based on tier level to more easily understand.
[*] Player stats screen now includes receivers in rushing stats.
[*] Field stat messages cleaned up to try and resolve missing stat issues.
[*] Messages running into the right side of screen adjusted to try to resolve issue.
[*] Fixed broken plays in plays file.
[*] Improved performance and memory usage used to store custom images when using mods.
[*] Fixed crash that would occur after winning championship game.
[*] Updated patch notes link.
[*] Miscellaneous fixes and updates.
[/list]
[h2]Thank you[/h2]

Our team is excited to show you what we have in the store, thank you for the patience and continued support!

If you experience any bugs or issues please report them here or more preferably in our [url=https://discord.gg/3yPN2DG]Discord[/url] where you can chat with the community, report bugs, or give feedback on the game.

As always, if you've enjoyed the game so far and like what you're seeing out of the game it would be great if you can leave a review on Steam! 🙏
